{{Top|leg}}
A '''pulse bomb''', also known as an '''EMP bomb''',<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> was a form of explosive weapon was developed by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] that saw widespread use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> The bomb was very powerful as it would cause heavy damage when detonated but it was also extremely dangerous. [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] used these bombs on [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] Palace on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]</ref> The [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] from one such bomb that threatened to destroy the [[Jedi Temple's computer core]] and the entity [[Abeloth]] with it was used by [[Saba Sebatyne]] and her forces in order to draw Abeloth out to her physical form during the [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
